cases.name: Madeline May Wegner Kim
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a wonderful, talented, warm hearted young woman who touched so many lives with her beautiful smile and caring ways. She was with the National Guard for 10 years had been working for the US Army. She was finishing her degree in Health Science/Health Care Administration at UW Milwaukee. She was a volunteer for a Women’s Abuse Center and also graduated from Faribault High School in 2009."
